decisions.reason: The organic sliced salami platter sits squarely within the firm's curing and salami know-how and its strategic organic expansion, and it stayed visible on the website for two years, so the firm can interpret its results and refine it.

The premium salami snack builds directly on core salami expertise and was extended with a poultry variant in 2024, which signals active learning and investment rather than withdrawal, even though it moved from its own page to a mention.

Organic boiled pork sausage is a classic charcuterie item that extends the firm's established processing knowledge into its growing organic line, and it was freshly launched with its own page in 2024.

Organic thin-sliced chicken breast is a step further from the core salami and sausage know-how, and the earlier organic poultry snack was dropped, but it fits the organic format expansion and launched recently in two variants, so the firm will likely give it more time.
The organic herb-coated salami draws on the firm's in-house seasoning and maturation expertise and fits the organic strategy, so the firm can readily assimilate market feedback on it.
